instruction: Configure the system-wide environment variables by adding a new PATH entry in /etc/environment.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because modifying /etc/environment requires root privileges and system-level write access. Similar to the Python symlink task, agents cannot modify system configuration files that affect all users without elevated permissions that are unavailable in the sandbox.
